items.title: Joseph Rene Interview, 1960-09-08
items.q: Well, we had everybody in there. You ever know a fella, Flowers?

ctx.x: You always played with your brother's band in the street, huh?

No, well, I tell you what we had, we had, they used to call it Gut Bucket Band. Mm-hmm. See, we didn't have no no-name band. You see, we just, he would get the job and just hire the band, you see. Well, we had everybody in there. You ever know a fella, Flowers? You ever heard of a fella, Flowers? He used to play band. I believe he played Appetite, too.
I've heard plenty of talk about it, he goes in and out of town, I can never go catch him.
